title: Redslate
description: Use other stones, namely cobbled deepslate and blackstone, to craft redstone components like pistons and observers that usually can only be crafted with cobblestone.
body:
Use other stones, namely cobbled deepslate and blackstone, to craft redstone components like pistons and observers that usually can only be crafted with cobblestone. Also craft comparators and repeaters using deepslate as well as with regular stone.

![Redslate Crafting Recipe Example Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5o9bmu1j/images/cc2e2cad6dc4200440f01f06b6815b9eec110aa8.png)
